name: @ocs/classical
//: Classical ciphers: encryption you can break with a pencil. A separate family from @ocs/cipher because there is a category difference rather than a spectrum -- these have no key bytes, no block, no nonce and no mode, their alphabet is 26 letters rather than 256 byte values, and their output is text. Filing Caesar under the same heading as AES-GCM would imply they are the same kind of thing at different strengths. See the note on ToolFamily. `./manifests` is eager and dependency-free; `./definition` is the on-demand half that reaches @ocs/algos.
